entries.description: Can be eaten and satisfies hunger.
Makes ill whoever eats or drinks it.
Can be drunk and satisfies thirst.
Salty; drinking it makes thirstier instead of quenching thirst.
Eases illness or pain when used.
Stays good to eat for a long time.
Burns when lit.
Throws sparks when struck against a suitable stone.
Sticks things together.
Can be pulled into fibres.
Can be braided or woven.
Keeps warmth in or cold out.
Solid and hard to break.
Has a sharp edge or point; cuts or pricks.
Splits into flat pieces.
Marks can be scratched into it.
Can be shaped by hand while moist.
Becomes hard when fired.
Cools what touches it.
Usable to build with.
Can hold other things.
Small and light enough to be carried.
Is hot to the touch.
